description: This file defines the ModuleStatusChange event class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Core Event namespace. It encapsulates the state change of a Module object, holding references to the previous and current Module instances.

classes.name: ModuleStatusChange
classes.description: An event class representing the change in status of a Module, storing references to previous and current Module objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with previous and current Module instances.

methods.name: getPreviousModule
methods.description: Returns the Module instance representing the previous state.

methods.name: getCurrentModule
methods.description: Returns the Module instance representing the current state.
